name: Rebuff
what_it_does: Prompt-injection detection library. Combines heuristics, vector-similarity to a corpus of known injections, and an LLM classifier; used both as a runtime defense and as a probe to evaluate defenses.
what_it_doesnt_do: Not a comprehensive red-team harness — focused on PI detection. Like all pattern-and-classifier defenses, it can be bypassed by novel encodings; treat as defense in depth, not the sole gate.
best_for: Generating evaluation prompts that target your existing defenses
not_for: Replacing structured prompting and least-privilege tool authorization
